facts.title: Undergraduate enrollment
facts.fact: Fall 2024 undergraduate enrollment was 29,271, up 3% from fall 2023.

facts.title: UT System position
facts.fact: UTA is the second-largest institution in The University of Texas System.

facts.title: International students
facts.fact: Students from 98 countries were enrolled in fall 2024.

facts.title: Research classification
facts.fact: UTA is a Carnegie R-1 "Very High Research Activity" institution.

facts.title: Minority-serving designations
facts.fact: UTA is designated a Hispanic-Serving Institution (HSI) and an Asian American Native American Pacific Islander-Serving Institution (AANAPISI).

facts.title: Seal of Excelencia
facts.fact: UTA has earned the Seal of Excelencia from Excelencia in Education.

facts.title: Financial aid
facts.fact: UTA students received $400 million in financial aid (fall 2024 reporting).

facts.title: Tuition fully covered
facts.fact: In fall 2024, 49% of undergraduates and 44% of new freshmen had their full tuition and fees covered by financial aid.

facts.title: Pell Grant recipients
facts.fact: 47.5% of undergraduates received Pell Grants in fall 2024.

facts.title: WSJ ranking
facts.fact: UTA is ranked the No. 1 university in North Texas by The Wall Street Journal (2025).

facts.title: Veterans ranking
facts.fact: UTA is ranked the No. 1 public university in Texas for veterans by Military Times (2024).

facts.title: Social mobility ranking
facts.fact: U.S. News & World Report (2025) ranks UTA No. 1 in North Texas and No. 36 nationally for advancing social mobility.

facts.title: Undergraduate diversity
facts.fact: U.S. News & World Report (2024) ranks UTA No. 5 in the U.S. for undergraduate ethnic diversity.

facts.title: Economic impact
facts.fact: UTA has a $28.8 billion annual economic impact on Texas.

facts.title: About UTA (boilerplate)
facts.fact: Located in the heart of the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex, The University of Texas at Arlington is a comprehensive teaching, research, and public service institution dedicated to the advancement of knowledge through scholarship and creative work.
